messages:
Priya (VP Infra): quick follow-up from the all-hands infra segment \u2014 starting a short thread to clarify regional quotas, burst credits, and a couple of H100 questions. drop short Qs.

Kofi (Capacity): what exactly are "burst credits"? is that a pooled token for burst allocation or per-customer quota?

Priya (VP Infra): burst credits = a short-term pool per-region used to absorb transient peaks (not per-customer). theyre consumed before we open cross-region fallback. designed to avoid oscillation for short spikes.

Rosa (SRE): so if credits drain, we start cross-region routing immediately or try to reprovision? what's the sequence?

Kofi (Capacity): sequence = consume burst credits -> try warm-pool scale-up (if available in-region) -> reprovision from regional reserve (~60-120s) -> cross-region fallback.

Nina (Product): for customer-facing docs, what wording should Sales use for latency expectations during fallback?

Priya (VP Infra): use: "typical cross-region fallback adds ~50-160ms; Dedicated pinning avoids cross-region routing." short and safe.

Jules (Runtime): any update on cold-start jitter for aggressive quantized models? last week we saw 3s variability on init.

Priya (VP Infra): runtime team is gating aggressive quant profiles from warm pools until init jitter <1.2s for our target models. Jules will publish a small table.

Rosa (SRE): autoscaler sawtooth still happening during priming windows. can we exclude priming spikes from scaling triggers?

Kofi (Capacity): yes  adding traffic.tag=priming and a soft ignore threshold (5% cluster) so autoscaler filters priming spikes. also experimenting with a 10m backoff after a scale event to avoid oscillation.

finance-bot: cost-estimate: warm-pool (2 nodes/zone) incremental = approx $6.8k/month/zone (SKU dependent).

Nina (Product): H100 pilot ask: are we doing limited pilot customers before Dedicated opt-in? customers want early access for benchmarks.

Priya (VP Infra): plan = pilot cohort (3 customers) during first week after arrival, then open Dedicated opt-in after 4 weeks pending telemetry. pilot invites by Product/Sales.

Jules (Runtime): one ops note: recommend adding a Console flag for "allow-warm-pool" per model variant so PMs can see eligibility.

Priya (VP Infra): agreed  adding model-eligibility flag to model-catalog. will be in docs this week.

Rosa (SRE): runbook doc link? want to update the failover playbook with the exact thresholds.

Priya (VP Infra): runbook link: https://redwood.company/runbooks/infra-failover (will add thresholds: burst-credit=0, error-rate>5% => immediate rollback).

Kofi (Capacity): ACTIONS: 1) Jules to publish quant-profile jitter table by Wed. 2) Kofi to add priming tag + autoscaler ignore rule this sprint. 3) Priya to update model-catalog flag + runbook thresholds. 4) Product to coordinate H100 pilot invites.

Nina (Product): acked  will coordinate pilots.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks all  if anything big, open a ticket in #eng-oncall. closing thread after actions are tracked.
